$comment: Written by scripts/import-history.mjs from public archives (nflverse for the NFL, cfbfastR-data for college). One record per regular-season game, as arrays in the order `fields` gives. Spreads are the home team's, negative when it is favoured; homeFair is the de-vigged moneyline probability of a home win; margin is home minus away. Read by scripts/calibrate.mjs and scripts/backtest.mjs, never by the browser.
